## Ignore Visual Studio temporary files, build results, and
## files generated by popular Visual Studio add-ons.

# User-specific files
*.rsuser
*.suo
*.user
*.userosscache
*.sln.docstates

# Build results
bin/
obj/

# Visual Studio cache/options directory
.vs/

# Rider
.idea/

# VS Code
.vscode/

# Logs
*.log

# NuGet
*.nupkg
*.snupkg
packages/
.nuget/

# ASP.NET Scaffolding
ScaffoldingReadMe.txt

# Entity Framework
*.mdf
*.ldf

# Publish output
publish/
wwwroot/dist/
wwwroot/lib/

# Node modules (if frontend tooling is used)
node_modules/

# Environment files
.env
.env.*

# Application settings overrides
appsettings.Development.json
appsettings.Local.json

# OS generated files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# Test Results
TestResults/

# Coverage reports
coverage/
*.coverage
*.coveragexml

# Docker
docker-compose.override.yml

# Azure
.publishsettings

# JetBrains Rider
*.sln.iml
